_help: Darkroom prompt templates, one block per model. {placeholders} are filled by src/shared/prompts.ts. Empty optional parts are dropped cleanly. Sources and reasoning: docs/PROMPT_AUDIT.md. Keep Klein text as plain prose; Qwen text may be structured; video text describes motion only.

klein.ref_hint: Refer to references in plain words, e.g. "the jacket from image 2".
klein.instruct: {instruction} Keep the composition, the people and all other details exactly as they are.
klein.instruct_masked: {instruction} Keep everything outside the edited area exactly as it is.
klein.inpaint: {fill}, blending seamlessly into the surrounding scene with matching lighting, perspective, colour and texture.
klein.outpaint: Continue the scene beyond its original edges{surroundings}, matching the existing lighting, perspective, colour palette and style.
klein.outpaint_default: Continue the scene beyond its original edges, matching the existing lighting, perspective, colour palette and style.

qwen.ref_hint: Refer to references as <image1>, <image2>, <image3> in the prompt.
qwen.instruct_masked: {instruction} Keep the rest of the image unchanged.
qwen.inpaint: Perform inpainting on this image. Fill the marked area with {fill}.{caption}
qwen.outpaint: Extend the image beyond its boundaries using outpainting.{caption}{surroundings}
qwen.caption: The original caption is: {text}
qwen.transparent: This is an RGBA image with transparency. {prompt} The image has alpha channel and the background is transparent.

wan.fallback: The subject moves naturally with small, realistic motions while the scene stays calm.
wan.hint: Describe what moves and how the camera moves - not what the picture shows. Under 100 words.

ltx.fallback: The scene comes gently to life: the subject makes small natural movements, fabric and hair shift slightly in the air, and light flickers softly across the surfaces.
ltx.hint: One flowing present-tense paragraph, 4-8 sentences: what moves, how the camera moves, and any sound. Don't describe the still picture.
